controls.title: Physical security policy
controls.objective: A written physical security policy is approved by management and reviewed at least every 24 months.

evidence.description: Policy with approval and review dates

questions.text: Is there a written physical security policy approved by management and reviewed within the last 24 months?
questions.guidance: Partial: policy exists but approval or review is older than 24 months.

controls.title: Site security risk assessment
controls.objective: A documented security risk assessment for the site was completed within the last 36 months.

questions.text: Has a documented security risk assessment covering this site been completed in the last 36 months?
questions.guidance: Partial: completed but older than 36 months, or not site specific.

questions.text: Were the recommendations from that assessment tracked to closure with owners and dates?

controls.title: Emergency plans and drills
controls.objective: Emergency action plans cover evacuation, shelter, and lockdown, and are exercised at least every 12 months.

evidence.description: Emergency action plan and drill records

questions.text: Is there a documented emergency action plan covering evacuation, shelter in place, and lockdown?
questions.guidance: Partial: one or more scenarios missing.

questions.text: Months since the last drill or exercise of the emergency action plan

references.note: paraphrase; source not checked from the build container

controls.title: Security awareness training
controls.objective: Staff receive security awareness training covering physical threats at least every 12 months.

questions.text: Percentage of staff who completed security awareness training covering tailgating, visitor challenge, and reporting in the last 12 months

controls.title: Personnel screening
controls.objective: Staff and contractors with unescorted access are screened before access, consistent with local law.

evidence.description: Screening policy and a sample of records

questions.text: Are background checks completed before unescorted access is granted to staff and contractors, as allowed by local law?
questions.guidance: Sample 5 recent hires or contractors. Partial: staff screened but contractors not.

controls.title: Document and media destruction
controls.objective: Sensitive documents and media are destroyed by cross-cut shredding or certified destruction, with records.

questions.text: Are sensitive documents and media placed in locked bins and destroyed by cross-cut shredding or a certified service with destruction certificates?
questions.guidance: Partial: shredding without certificates, or open bins. Photograph open bins holding sensitive material.

controls.title: Critical areas not advertised
controls.objective: Signs, directories, and door labels do not identify critical rooms to the public.

evidence.description: Photo of each sign identifying a critical area

questions.text: Are public directories, signs, and door labels free of wording that identifies critical rooms (server room, cash room, chemical storage, security office)?
questions.guidance: Code-required hazard signage is exempt; note it. Photograph each revealing sign.
